'''Leona's parents''' are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP063|Hot Springing a Leak!]]''. They run a [[Sinnoh]] hot spring hotel along with their daughter [[Leona]], a close friend of {{an|Dawn}}'s.

Eventually, their hot spring water was stolen by someone. After tracing their water pipe, they discovered a new one was attached and used their {{p|Wooper}} to find the culprits. When {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and Leona arrived on the scene, they met Leona's parents. Dawn informed them that {{TRT}} was behind the scheme, though the pair enjoyed Team Rocket's {{motto}} and almost forgot about their criminal activity. Their daughter, Ash, and his friends eventually managed to defeat Team Rocket, allowing Leona's parents to redirect the water back to their hot springs.

Afterwards, they invited Ash and his friends back to their hotel for a hot spring bath as thanks before waving them goodbye.
